b1-28-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Rules at the Factory
b1-28-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the rules are at the factory. You (Meg) say that making phone calls is forbidden there and that wearing a cap is mandatory.
b1-28-01.prompt: Tell Petra what is forbidden and what is mandatory at the factory.
cues: Say what is forbidden at the factory
Say what is mandatory there
b1-28-01.target: A gyárban tilos telefonálni. Sapkát kötelező viselni.
b1-28-01.english: At the factory it is forbidden to make phone calls. It is mandatory to wear a cap.
b1-28-01.canDo: I can say what is forbidden or mandatory, with tilos and kötelező + infinitive.

b1-28-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Work Still to Do
b1-28-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg what is still open at work. You (Meg) say that there is one task still to be solved and that the amount to be paid is large.
b1-28-02.prompt: Tell Károly what task is still open and how large the amount is.
cues: Say that a task is still to be solved
Say that the amount to be paid is large
b1-28-02.target: Van egy megoldandó feladat. A fizetendő összeg nagy.
b1-28-02.english: There is a task to be solved. The amount to be paid is large.
b1-28-02.canDo: I can say what has to be done, with -andó/-endő participles like megoldandó.

b1-28-03.title: Communicative Challenge: An Exception for a Student
b1-28-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the teacher decided about a student who was ill. You (Meg) say that out of fairness the teacher made an exception for the ill student.
b1-28-03.prompt: Tell Petra what the teacher did for the ill student.
cues: Say who made the exception
Say why the teacher did it
Say who the exception was for
b1-28-03.target: A tanár méltányosságból kivételt tett a beteg diákkal.
b1-28-03.english: Out of fairness the teacher made an exception for the ill student.
b1-28-03.canDo: I can make or refuse an exception, with kivételt tesz and méltányosságból.

b1-28-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Guarantee on the Phone
b1-28-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg what the manufacturer promised when she bought the new phone. You (Meg) say that the manufacturer gives a guarantee on the phone for three years.
b1-28-04.prompt: Tell Károly what the manufacturer promised for the phone.
cues: Say who gives the guarantee
Say how long it lasts
Say what it covers
b1-28-04.target: A gyártó három évre garanciát nyújt a telefonra.
b1-28-04.english: The manufacturer gives a guarantee on the phone for three years.
b1-28-04.canDo: I can undertake a commitment or give a guarantee, with kötelezettséget vállal and garanciát nyújt.

b1-28-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Rejection
b1-28-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what her colleague is doing about the rejection of his request. You (Meg) say that the colleague appeals against the decision and demands justice.
b1-28-05.prompt: Tell Petra what your colleague does against the decision.
cues: Say that your colleague appeals
Say that he demands justice
b1-28-05.target: A kollégám fellebbez a döntés ellen. Igazságot követel.
b1-28-05.english: My colleague appeals against the decision. He demands justice.
b1-28-05.canDo: I can say that someone appeals against a decision, with jogorvoslattal él and fellebbez.

b1-28-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Red Umbrella
b1-28-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Szent Péter esernyője is about. You (Meg) say that György looked for the money in the umbrella but found Veronka instead.
b1-28-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what György looked for and what he found.
cues: Say what György looked for
Say whom he found
b1-28-consolidation.target: György a pénzt kereste az esernyőben. Veronkát találta meg.
b1-28-consolidation.english: György looked for the money in the umbrella. He found Veronka.
b1-28-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a lawyer, a priest's sister and a red umbrella, in a few sentences.

b1-31-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Metro
b1-31-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg when the new metro starts running. You (Meg) say that it is expected to start next summer and that, with good chances, many people will use it.
b1-31-01.prompt: Tell Petra when the new metro is expected to start and that many people will probably use it.
cues: Say when the metro is expected to start
Say that many people will probably use it, and how likely that is
b1-31-01.target: Az új metró várhatóan jövő nyáron indul. Jó eséllyel sokan fogják használni.
b1-31-01.english: The new metro is expected to start next summer. With good chances many people will use it.
b1-31-01.canDo: I can say how likely something is with várhatóan, előreláthatólag and jó eséllyel.

b1-31-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Working From Home
b1-31-02.scenario: Károly says that more and more people work from home. You (Meg) say that remote work is gaining more and more ground and that the world of work is changing.
b1-31-02.prompt: Tell Károly what is gaining ground and what is happening to the world of work.
cues: Say what is gaining ground
Say that the world of work is changing
b1-31-02.target: A távmunka egyre nagyobb teret hódít. A munka világa most átalakulóban van.
b1-31-02.english: Remote work is gaining more and more ground. The world of work is in the process of transforming now.
b1-31-02.canDo: I can say that a trend is gaining ground with teret hódít.

b1-31-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Tasks Ahead
b1-31-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she thinks the city should do about the future. You (Meg) say that a lot of work still lies ahead and that climate change is a task to be solved today.
b1-31-03.prompt: Tell Petra that much work lies ahead and which task must be solved.
cues: Say that much work still lies ahead
Say which task has to be solved
b1-31-03.target: Sok elvégzendő munka vár még ránk. A klímaváltozás ma egy megoldandó feladat.
b1-31-03.english: Much work to be done still awaits us. Climate change is a task to be solved today.
b1-31-03.canDo: I can name a task that is still ahead with a participle in -andó/-endő.

b1-31-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Fear and Hope
b1-31-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she feels about the future. You (Meg) say that many people fear that machines will take their work, but that the ideas of the young give cause for optimism.
b1-31-04.prompt: Tell Károly what many people fear and what gives you cause for optimism.
cues: Say what many people fear
Say what gives you cause for optimism
b1-31-04.target: Sokan tartanak attól, hogy a gépek elveszik a munkájukat. A fiatalok ötletei bizakodásra adnak okot.
b1-31-04.english: Many people fear that machines will take their work. The ideas of the young give cause for optimism.
b1-31-04.canDo: I can say what causes concern or gives cause for hope with aggodalmat kelt and bizakodásra ad okot.

b1-31-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Decisions Today
b1-31-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg how today's decisions about energy will look in the future. You (Meg) say that from the perspective of twenty years we see them differently and that every decision today has serious consequences.
b1-31-05.prompt: Tell Petra how we will see today's decisions in twenty years and that they have consequences.
cues: Say from what distance in time you look
Say that today's decisions have serious consequences
b1-31-05.target: Húsz év távlatából másként látjuk a mai döntéseket. Minden mai döntésünk súlyos következményekkel jár.
b1-31-05.english: From the perspective of twenty years we see today's decisions differently. Every decision of ours today has serious consequences.
b1-31-05.canDo: I can look ahead with húsz év távlatából.

b1-31-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Éva and Ádám
b1-31-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg how Madách's story ends. You (Meg) say that Éva tells Ádám she is expecting a child and that Ádám gets hope again.
b1-31-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what Éva tells Ádám and what Ádám feels afterwards.
cues: Say what Éva tells Ádám
Say what Ádám gets afterwards
b1-31-consolidation.target: Éva azt mondja Ádámnak, hogy gyereket vár. Ádám újra reményt kap.
b1-31-consolidation.english: Éva tells Ádám that she is expecting a child. Ádám gets hope again.
b1-31-consolidation.canDo: I can retell in a few sentences how Ádám finds hope at the end of Az ember tragédiája.
